cases.title: scrolls to the top for a bare # and for #top with nothing carrying that id

cases.title: routes a fragment href that belongs to another document

cases.title: opens nothing for a middle click on a link

cases.title: leaves a middle click the document dispatched itself alone

cases.title: ignores a press that is not on a link at all
cases.reason: A trusted non-link press does not route or cancel ordinary document interactions.
